children.name: Sinoflustra amoyensis
children.description: Colony encrusting, multiserial, unilamellar. Ancestrula and early astogeny not observed. Autozooids subrectangular, rounded distally, slender, typically twice as long as wide, 0.43 – 0.63 mm long by 0.18 – 0.28 mm wide; zooidal boundaries marked by a narrow fissure; opesia occupying two-thirds of frontal surface, elongate inverted pear-shaped; cryptocyst convex, widest proximally, narrowing distally, covered by small pustules, about 10 – 16 cryptocystal spinules extending from mural rim over proximal two-thirds of opesia, but not meeting, distal third of opesia broad and spineless (Fig. 5 F); gymnocyst lacking. Spines present at distolateral corners of autozooids, spines broken off in studied specimens, leaving a small rounded triangular base with a central pore (Fig. 5 F). Avicularia not observed.

children.name: Sinoflustra annae
children.description: Colony encrusting, unilaminar, uniserial to multiserial, fragile. Autozooids rectangular, longer than wide (LZ 446 – 589 µm [498 ± 52, N = 20]; WZ 195 – 341 µm [264 ± 44, N = 20]), autozooidal margin indistinct (Fig. 8 A). Cryptocyst well developed proximally, granular, wide, becoming narrower in some zooids. Opesia subrectangular to ovoidal (LOp 379 – 487 µm [426 ± 31, N = 20]; WOp 147 – 290 µm [211 ± 49, N = 20]), occupying two-thirds of autozooidal length, surrounded by a spinous cryptocyst; opesia more circular and broader just before the bifurcation; rim raised, crenulated, with 10 – 12 slender spines occupying almost entirely its proximal and lateral regions. Operculum distal, straight to slightly curved, well developed. Avicularia vicarious, spatulate, longer than wide (LAv 650 – 696 µm [677 ± 23, N = 2]; WAv 195 – 248 µm [221 ± 26, N = 2]), almost twice the size of an autozooid; cryptocyst granular, narrow, wider proximally (Fig. 8 C). A row of uniporous mural septula on distal (Fig. 8 B) and lateral transverse walls (Fig. 8 D). Kenozooids absent.
